content: Haaru navutaaka tinavu rumpa vare vo vataini vuru kaamanta vauraro Noravano Kotiva vihairo tinavu kuvantu kero tivita varero Saioni Aiqinaqaa viri kaimanta tenavu tiha, Oho, tenavu qaqi tairama tave vauro, turaro quqaa vi entara Kotiva mintima timitaira.

Kotiva mintima timitaimanta tenavu voqamake quaheha naaraihamaqi viha, vira ihi tiva amitaqi vunara. Tenavu mintiaqi vuramanta vo vatanaa vo vatanaaka tinavu tave tiha, Ike, Noravano Kotiva Isareriara iriharo nora kaiqa vara nimitaivo, tiara.
Quqaama, Noravano Kotiva nora kaiqa tinavu vara timitaivaro vi entara tinavu muntukaqihairo koqe imanta vaunara.
Mpo Noravauvo, are qaiqaavata tinavu koqema timitairaqe tenavu koqemake variqi vuare. Aahara vataqaa aaqu ntivaro qaiqaa namarivano tuvintema kera, are tinavu qaiqaa koqema timitaane.
Are qaqi kairamanta iqi rateha kara ututaaka naantiara quaheha kara mpeqaiqinara qantuate.
Vika iqi rateha kuvukanaa ututaaka, naantiara vika quahe ihira tivaqi viha, kara mpeqaiqinara qantu vare anivarave.
